integrity: The recurrence and proof are stated self-containedly.
The cited literature establishes the chain Catalan-monoid context, not the rooted-tree recurrence.
Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to finite rooted-tree posets with ancestor order.
Counts ordered pairs of idempotents, not maximal commuting families or arbitrary self-maps.
No asymptotic theorem for varying tree shapes is claimed.
title: A three-state recurrence for commuting idempotents on rooted trees
